purpose: Replace type-only labels for the Type-0x43 interaction activation and Type-0x44/0x45 response-counter paths.

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ActivateType43Interaction

contract.activation: When TERRAIN_LANDING_STATE is set, converts the actor to type 0x8A and installs the embedded Type-0x43/0x8A interaction animation entry
contract.state: Temporarily aligns PLAYER_X, rebuilds derived camera coordinates, publishes RAW_TERRAIN_QUERY_STATE as 0xFF, and restores PLAYER_X
contract.audio: Optionally queues audio command 0x63 when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is active

evidence: Direct actor type 0x8A and embedded animation-root writes
Direct camera rebuild, terrain-query publication, and command-0x63 audio path

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ApplyDifficultyResponseStep

contract.response: Advances INTERACTION_RESPONSE_CURRENT by 3 minus GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE and clamps it to INTERACTION_RESPONSE_PENDING
contract.handoff: Transfers to Actor_ReinitializeFromCollisionTemplate after the optional command-0x62 audio path

evidence: Direct GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE, current-response, and pending-response accesses
Direct bounded update and shared collision-template reinitialization transfer

contract.handoff: Transfers to Actor_ReinitializeFromCollisionTemplate after the optional command-0x62 audio path

conclusion: The promoted names distinguish Type-0x43 interaction activation from the Type-0x44 difficulty-scaled response step and Type-0x45 pending-response commit while retaining dispatch-type aliases.
